units.translation: nominative of the third person reflexive pronoun, of which there are no examples in Aeschylus, very few in others, about which I have spoken in the Lexicon Sophocleum p. 228.
Thus Porson for ἰαχάν [cry]. The same form restored on metrical grounds in Eur. El. 143, Tro. 337, Iph. A. 1039. On the accent see Arcad. p. 115, 25.
I will send — a tearful cry
to Dodona he sent frequent envoys
seeking me, the godless woman sends me
send Justice as an ally to your friends
sent from the house I went
unless κουφίσματα [reliefs] is to be written, about which I have spoken under the word ἔρεισμα [support].
these groans are remedies for toils

Hesychius ἰαμβίς: Aeschylus in Theoroes or Isthmiastae (fr. 74). The flute accompanied those playing the cithara, and such cithara performances were called παριαμβίδες [songs accompanied by flute]: on which see Thes. under the word παριαμβίς.
iambis: Aeschylus in Theoroes or Isthmiastae
the flute accompanied those playing the cithara, and such cithara performances were called par-iambides

The meter is anapaestic monometer hypercatalectic. It is very remarkable that ᾿Ιάνων [of the Ionians] is said with the second syllable shortened. With the lengthened, which is the legitimate measure, it is used at v. 1025 Ἰάνων λαὸς οὐ φυγαίχμας [the people of the Ionians, not fleeing from battle], if Passow is right. ἰαόνων [of the Ionians] M. Ιάων [Ionian] Hermann.
For he robbed the Ionians, the ship-protecting Ares of the Ionians
the people of the Ionians, not fleeing from battle
do not heal evils with evils
thus from the apograph for ἰάνων [of the Ionians]
he goes to the land of the Ionians
having met with the sailors of the Ionians
they hurl a jagged stone at the citizens who are in doubt
before the gates he will hurl his head
no longer shooting arrows at us
and he hurls mortals from high-towered hopes to utter destruction
and he hurls through the land of Asia
most arrows are hurled at this man
you cannot find with what medicines you are curable
and fasting pains are most excellent at teaching the mind's physician-prophets
he is a physician-prophet and a diviner
(with first syllable of variable length) physician
for the sake of a physician
which in the house was the physician of the fine Bacchic revelry, hope
O Death – for you alone are the physician of incurable evils
words are physicians of boiling anger
